AMBER BRAIN v4 (keeper and seekers share this code)
1. Keeper: one clue word, not on the grid, not inside a grid word. Each target needs a standard compound or set phrase (tigerfish, pillowcase, sewing needle).
2. Default: number 1 with one standard compound and no rival partner on the grid.
3. Number 2+: only if every target has a named link AND no other grid word (teal, fog, shadow) takes the clue. A shared colour set can work (white: pearl, silk, marble).
4. Rival scan: list every grid word that takes the clue. If two partners exist, drop the weaker or change the clue. Name in the reason which partner is ours.
5. Number = exact count of our hidden words pointed to. Name targets privately.
6. Seekers: read the clue as its strongest compound; guess that word first.
7. Number 1: one own hit, then endGuesses.
8. Number 2+: next guess is the next-strongest compound. Stop once the number is met.
9. Doubtful second link: endGuesses, not a guess. Flag doubts in team chat first.
10. Fog, rival or shadow ends the turn; accept it.
11. Landed: fish+tiger, case+pillow, sewing+needle, space+orbit/falcon, apple+pine, party+trumpet, white+pearl/silk/marble.
12. Misled: fish+rabbit (rabbit was teal), case+pencil (equal rival, teal), sea+lighthouse (teal), fish+lantern (fog).
